title: Cycle detection in a disconnected undirected graph
summary: Both Guava distributions detected the triangle after an isolated node disabled the edge-count shortcut. Adding another acyclic component preserved the positive result.

change.description: Graphs.hasCycle continues to examine the remaining neighbors after encountering the edge by which it reached a vertex.

notes: The triangle remains intact. The extra components change the edge-to-node count, which governs the shortcut described by the PR.
